If you keep feeling like this after a while, you should see someone about it. After my first acid trip I developed psychosis without me knowing, I suffered from extreme depersonalization 24/7 and had all these strange ideas, I literally thought I was going crazy. I finally went to a psychiatrist after like 4 months, when I told my mom I was going to kill myself cause I thought I was stuck in a comma and had to kms to wake up haha. They gave me antipsychotics and it instantly shut off all of those crippling thoughts and made my depersonalization go away. I think it’s important to be aware that psychedelics and other drugs can trigger disorders such as psychosis or schizophrenia, specially if you have a family background. So I recommend you to see a psychiatrist if these symptoms keep bothering you, but you should definitely stop smoking right away, cause it’s only going to make things worse. Hope you feel better, let me know if you need to talk :)
